_comment: Settings for edge/vision.py, owned by the model team. N and K: a cat must be seen in the trap zone in K of the last N frames. thresholds: minimum confidence per class. Zones are normalized (0..1) polygons, x left to right, y top to bottom. Status: cat cutoff 0.15 and 3-of-5 vote were chosen for E1 on Oct 24. On E1b, 0.15 gives 8.4% false positives on animals at 640 pixels, above the under-5% goal, so re-tune from the 416-pixel score. Zones are PLACEHOLDERS until the camera is mounted: redraw with python -m edge.draw_zones. same_animal_iou: two boxes of different classes overlapping this much are one animal; the weaker label is dropped only if the stronger one is at least same_animal_margin more confident (close calls keep both, so a non-cat still holds the gate open).
